messages:
maria: heads-up, hitting a confusing parity/shape issue with the Python async SDK when I try to do embeddings + rerank in the same flow.

maria: repro sketch: async client, batch 64 docs, call embeddings.create(input=docs) then pass embeddings to rerank API. sometimes embeddings come back as nested lists (extra dims) and rerank expects flat vectors -> ValueError during scoring. also observed intermittent 401s mid-batch when we keep the long-lived AsyncClient alive.

maria: minimal snippet:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=MY_KEY)
docs = ["a","b","c"]
emb = await client.embeddings.create(model="embed-v1", input=docs)
# emb currently: {"data": [{"embedding": [[0.1,0.2,...]]}, ...]}  <-- sometimes double-nested
# expected: {"data": [{"embedding": [0.1,0.2,...]}, ...]}
# then rerank call fails because we pass the wrong shape
```

jonathan: thanks for filing, this is super helpful. i think i saw something similar in an internal report. quick q: are you using the concurrency/batcher helper or raw calls?

maria: raw calls inside our own asyncio.gather with semaphore limiting to 8. i think the SDK batching might be folding inputs differently when requests are auto-batched vs manual lists.

jonathan: hmm. two things: 1) there's an open PR that normalizes embedding shape on the response for the sync client, but the async path missed one code path (we flatten for single-input vs multi-input inconsistently). PR #789 is the sync fix. 2) the 401 during long runs is probably token refresh race — async client refreshes token lazily and if a refresh hits mid-batch we sometimes surface a 401 instead of retrying.

priya: this is causing onboarding friction for a couple early customers — they copy the sample app and hit this, so they think our SDK is unstable. can we get a quick patch?

jonathan: agreed. plan: i'll push a small patch to the async response normalizer to always coerce to shape: list of vectors. will also add a retry around auth refresh in the http layer (idempotent for embeddings/rerank).

jonathan: short-term workaround for you (maria): post-process the response like:
```py
def normalize_vec(x):
    v = x.get("embedding")
    while isinstance(v[0], list):
        v = v[0]
    return v
embeddings = [normalize_vec(d) for d in emb['data']]
```

sam: would it help to ship a tiny "RerankBatcher" helper in the SDK that: takes inputs, runs embeddings (with internal batching), normalizes shapes, calls rerank and returns structured scores? that would hide all of this from users and reduce copy-paste.

jonathan: yes, that's on my TODO list. i can prototype RerankBatcher with options: max_batch, concurrency, auth_retry=True, typed return (List[Tuple[candidate, score]]). also add proper typing stubs for embeddings and rerank responses.

maria: that would be ideal. typing improvements will help our static checks too (we had a bug where mypy assumed embeddings -> List[List[float]] but actual union shape caused downstream type errors).

deploy-bot: test coverage report: api/async_client.py - new tests needed for token-refresh retry and response-normalization. failing CI on branch 'maria/embedding-smoke'.

jonathan: ok i'll add unit tests that mock token expiry mid-request and verify we transparently retry, and tests that exercise single vs batched embedding responses.

priya: timeline request from PM: can we aim for a patch release this week for the normalization + retry, and then a follow-up release with the RerankBatcher and typing in two weeks?

jonathan: yes — patch release for normalization+auth-retry by EOW if no blockers. will open an issue and assign.

maria: thanks! i'll attach a small repro (3 files) to the issue and link the customer report. will also add a short sample app snippet to the docs to show the normalize workaround. :+1:

sam: add a short note in the quickstart: "If you see unexpected nesting in embeddings, apply normalizeVec()" until we ship fix.

jonathan: assigning to me. i'll post the PR link here when ready.

maria: awesome — ping me for review.
